1  JUDGMENT The instant appeal has been filed by the claimant against the judgment and decree made in M.C.O.P.No.244 of 2012 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Chief Judicial Magistrate Court), Tirunelveli seeking enhancement of the compensation amount.

sentences.text: 2. The injured claimant had filed the above claim petition on the ground that he has sustained grievous injuries in an accident that had taken place on 05.04.2012.
3. According to the claimant, he was 40 years old and he was an Assistant Mason and had his monthly income of Rs.10,000/-.
As per the Ex.P.11 - Disability Certificate, the claimant had sustained 65% disability.

The Tribunal has reduced the percentage of disability from 65% to 45%
and thereafter, has proceeded to pass the award.
The Tribunal has fixed a sum of Rs.2,000/- per percentage for the disability and ultimately, has passed an award for a sum of Rs.1,96,600/-.
Challenging the said award, the present appeal has been filed.
4. According to the learned Counsel appearing for the appellant, a sum of Rs.4,000/- should have been awarded per percentage of disability.
He further https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis contented that the Tribunal has not assigned any reason for reducing the disability from 65% to 45%.
5. Per contra, the learned Counsel appearing for the respondent/Insurance Company herein contented that the Tribunal has fixed the reasonable award and there is no scope of enhancement.
6. I have carefully considered the submissions made on either side and perused the materials available on record.
7. As rightly pointed out by the learned Counsel appearing for the appellant, the Tribunal has reduced the percentage of disability from 65% as fixed under Ex.P.11 to 45%.
8. This Court is of the considered view that the disability could be fixed as 50%.
Considering the fact that the accident has taken place in the year 2012, a sum of Rs.3,000/- should have been awarded per percentage of disability.
9. In view of the above said discussions, the compensation amount is re
- assessed as follows:

2  4. Attendant Charges Rs.6,600/- Rs.6,600/- 
 5. 45% Disability Rs.90,000/- Rs.1,50,000/- 
 enhanced to 50%
 Disability  6. Loss of amenities Rs.15,000/- Rs.15,000/-
10. The award amount awarded by the Tribunal is enhanced from Rs.1,96,600/- to Rs.2,56,600/-.

The respondent/Insurance Company is directed to deposit the entire award amount along with interest at 7.5% p.a., from the date of claim petition till date of realisation, within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
On such deposit, the claimant is entitled to withdraw the same.
In other aspects, the award of the Tribunal stands confirmed.
11.With the above said observations, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed to the extent as stated above.
